import math

def main():
    a, b, n = map(int, input().split())
    best = float('inf')
    target = a / b
    x = y = 0
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        base = (j * a) // b
        for candidate in (base - 1, base, base + 1):
            cur = abs(candidate / j - target)
            if cur < best:
                best = cur
                x = candidate
                y = j
    g = math.gcd(x, y)
    print(f"{x // g}/{y // g}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
